BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

WITH RECURSIVE "_cte0" ("origin_id", "depth") AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST($1 AS uuid) AS "origin_id", CAST($2 AS bigint) AS "depth") AS "_recursive_anchor" UNION ALL SELECT "_t8"."target_id" AS "origin_id", ("_t0"."depth" + CAST($3 AS bigint)) AS "depth" FROM "_cte0" AS "_t0" CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "_t10"."id" AS "target_id", "_t9"."id" AS "edge_id", "_t10"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t10"."arch_module" AS "arch_module", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "_t9"."seq" ASC, "_t9"."id" ASC) AS "ord", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "arity" FROM "anchors" AS "_t9" INNER JOIN "anchors" AS "_t10" ON (("_t10"."id" = (CASE WHEN ("_t9"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") THEN "_t9"."dst" ELSE "_t9"."src" END)) AND ("_t10"."kind" = CAST($4 AS text)) AND ((CAST($5 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t10"."arch_type" = CAST($5 AS text)) OR ("_t10"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t11"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t11" WHERE ("_t11"."ancestor" = CAST($5 AS text))))) AND (("_t10"."root_id" = CAST($6 AS uuid)) OR (CAST((("_t10"."props" -> CAST($7 AS text)) ->> CAST($8 AS text)) AS bigint) > CAST($9 AS bigint)) OR (((("_t10"."props" -> CAST($7 AS text)) -> CAST($10 AS text)) -> CAST($11 AS text)) ? CAST($12 AS text)) OR EXISTS (SELECT CAST($13 AS bigint) AS "one" FROM "anchors" AS "_t12" WHERE (("_t12"."kind" = CAST($14 AS text)) AND ("_t12"."src" = CAST($6 AS uuid)) AND (((("_t10"."props" -> CAST($7 AS text)) -> CAST($15 AS text)) -> CAST($16 AS text)) ? CAST("_t12"."dst" AS text)))))) WHERE ((("_t9"."kind" = CAST($17 AS text)) AND (("_t9"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") OR ("_t9"."undirected" AND ("_t9"."dst" = "_t0"."origin_id"))) AND ((CAST($18 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t9"."arch_type" = CAST($18 AS text)) OR ("_t9"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t13"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t13" WHERE ("_t13"."ancestor" = CAST($18 AS text)))))))) AS "_t8" WHERE (("_t8"."arity" = CAST($19 AS bigint)) AND ("_t8"."arch_type" = CAST($20 AS text)) AND ("_t8"."arch_module" = CAST($21 AS text)) AND ("_t0"."depth" < CAST($22 AS bigint)))) SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST($23 AS bigint) AS "slot", "_t0"."depth" AS "depth", "_t0"."origin_id" AS "origin_id", "_t1"."target_id" AS "target_id", "_t1"."edge_id" AS "edge_id", "_t1"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t1"."arch_module" AS "arch_module", "_t1"."ord" AS "ord", "_t1"."arity" AS "arity" FROM "_cte0" AS "_t0" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "_t4"."id" AS "target_id", "_t3"."id" AS "edge_id", "_t4"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t4"."arch_module" AS "arch_module", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "_t3"."seq" ASC, "_t3"."id" ASC) AS "ord", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "arity" FROM "anchors" AS "_t3" INNER JOIN "anchors" AS "_t4" ON (("_t4"."id" = (CASE WHEN ("_t3"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") THEN "_t3"."dst" ELSE "_t3"."src" END)) AND ("_t4"."kind" = CAST($24 AS text)) AND ((CAST($25 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t4"."arch_type" = CAST($25 AS text)) OR ("_t4"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t5"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t5" WHERE ("_t5"."ancestor" = CAST($25 AS text))))) AND (("_t4"."root_id" = CAST($6 AS uuid)) OR (CAST((("_t4"."props" -> CAST($26 AS text)) ->> CAST($27 AS text)) AS bigint) > CAST($28 AS bigint)) OR (((("_t4"."props" -> CAST($26 AS text)) -> CAST($29 AS text)) -> CAST($30 AS text)) ? CAST($12 AS text)) OR EXISTS (SELECT CAST($31 AS bigint) AS "one" FROM "anchors" AS "_t6" WHERE (("_t6"."kind" = CAST($32 AS text)) AND ("_t6"."src" = CAST($6 AS uuid)) AND (((("_t4"."props" -> CAST($26 AS text)) -> CAST($33 AS text)) -> CAST($34 AS text)) ? CAST("_t6"."dst" AS text)))))) WHERE ((("_t3"."kind" = CAST($35 AS text)) AND (("_t3"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") OR ("_t3"."undirected" AND ("_t3"."dst" = "_t0"."origin_id"))) AND ((CAST($36 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t3"."arch_type" = CAST($36 AS text)) OR ("_t3"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t7"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t7" WHERE ("_t7"."ancestor" = CAST($36 AS text)))))))) AS "_t1" ON CAST($37 AS boolean)) AS "_set" ("slot", "depth", "origin_id", "target_id", "edge_id", "arch_type", "arch_module", "ord", "arity") ORDER BY "slot" ASC, "depth" ASC, "ord" ASC LIMIT CAST($38 AS bigint)

SELECT n1.id, e1.id, n1.arch_type, n1.arch_module FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.src = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.dst = f0.id)) AND (e1.arch_type = $2 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $3 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)) AND (n1.root_id = CAST($4 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($5 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($4 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id LIMIT 2049

CAST($5 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($4 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) JOIN anchors e2 ON e2.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e2.src = n1.id OR (e2.undirected AND e2.dst = n1.id)) AND (e2.arch_type = $6 OR e2.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $6)) JOIN anchors n2 ON n2.id = CASE WHEN e2.src = n1.id THEN e2.dst ELSE e2.src END AND n2.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n2.arch_type = $7 OR n2.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $7)) AND (n2.root_id = CAST($8 AS uuid) OR (n2.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n2.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($9 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($8 AS uuid) AND (n2.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id, e2.seq, e2.id LIMIT 2049
